E1 block — hooks/canonkit-hook.js:773-777 HARD_SECRET (private key, AKIA, AIza); Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit content denied at :1202-1205 via deny() (:370-378, permissionDecision 'deny'); shell writes of the same denied at :1155-1158. Lower-confidence credentials (sk-, ghp_ in quoted assignments) only ask (:779).

E2 block — :914-935 gitBypass covers --no-verify (and unambiguous prefixes), commit -n in a cluster, --no-gpg-sign, -c core.hooksPath and -c commit.gpgsign=false; denied at :1141-1148 for Bash and PowerShell alike.
E3 confirm — :509-525 highRisk (auth, secret paths, migrations, contracts, project includes); Edit/Write asks at :1218-1221 (permissionDecision 'ask', answered by the user).

E4 confirm — :785-795 shellWriteTargets (redirects, tee, Set-Content/Add-Content/Out-File/New-Item) feeds the same ask at :1182-1185 for both Bash and PowerShell, the two shells the Windows harness ships. Gap: cp, mv, sed -i, Copy-Item, Move-Item and interpreter one-liners are not parsed as writes.

E5 confirm — :486 CONFIG_PATH .claude/canonkit.json is the first rule in highRisk (:511), so edits and shell writes to the hook's own config ask. ~/.claude/settings.json (the wiring) and ~/.claude/hooks/canonkit-hook.js are not gated by the kit.

Off-switches: none found. The only env switch, CANONKIT_CONTEXT_BANDS=off (:226-241), disables the non-blocking context reminder. Unwiring the hook from settings.json is the harness's own switch, available against every kit, and was not counted.

Rules labeled [ENFORCED] in reference/routing-block.md (perf-budget loosening, gates, dispatch logging, no self-merge) each map to code: :1179/:1216 perf ask, :1164-1165 git ask, agent_start/agent_end logging (:1110-1128, :1038-1052), Stop gate (:960-1006). None is advisory-only.

Caveat: plain `npx canonkit install` copies the hook but does not register it (bin/cli.js:497-503 reportHookWiring); with that profile every item is absent. The README quickstart (README.md:39) uses --wire-hooks, which is why it was taken as the default. The hook is fail-open by design (hooks/canonkit-hook.js:36-37, :1231-1232).

notes: Partial re-score: only review-noise was re-read; every other score is carried from 2026-10-29-canonkit.json unchanged. First run of this target under rubric 1.0.0; no previous run, so no deltas. This audit ran under canonkit's own rules (~/AGENTS.md and ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md were loaded) and the rubric's knownBias applies: the enforcement checklist and governance anchors were written from canonkit's vocabulary. Read canonkit's 10s in enforcement and governance with that in mind. Other profile: plain `npx canonkit install` (no --wire-hooks) leaves the hook unregistered; enforcement would score 0 and doctor reports FAIL.
